Write this so a fresh contributor — or an agent running /work-next-item with no

-->

## Context
<!-- Why this is needed and the background required to act on it. Link related
issues with #NN. State constraints (stack, infra, external rules). -->

## Goal
<!-- The outcome in 1–2 sentences: what "done" looks like from the user's view. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Checkable, observable conditions. This is the definition of done. -->
- [ ]
- [ ]

## Implementation notes
<!-- Proposed approach, key files/endpoints, decisions and trade-offs. Enough
detail that a cold reader can start without re-deriving it. Flag any

## Out of scope
<!-- What this issue deliberately does NOT cover, and alternatives considered
and rejected (with the why). Prevents scope creep. -->

## Testing
<!-- How to validate: unit/integration tests to add or run, plus manual / E2E
